title: OpenAI valued at $1.25 trillion, as rival Anthropic nears its IPO
slides: Can OpenAI justify a $1.25 trillion price tag?
Its valuation now exceeds most S&P 500 companies.
Yet rival Anthropic is quietly nearing its own IPO.
Investors in both now face a real allocation choice.
Pick which AI bet you'd actually hold through a dip.
thread_text:
1. The $1.25T Question

OpenAI's valuation now tops most S&P 500 giants. That's a bet on future profits, not today's revenue.

2. Rivals Aren't Waiting

Anthropic is quietly moving toward its own IPO, giving investors a second pure-play AI option.

3. The Allocation Trap

Money flowing into one doesn't mean the other is ignored. Portfolios face a real either-or decision.

4. Who Survives a Dip?

High valuation means high expectations. Any stumble gets punished fast by the market.

5. Your Move

Which AI stock would you actually hold through a 30% drop? Write it down and check your conviction.

Which one would you hold through a market dip?
